caption: The drawing depicts a single, centrally positioned object resembling a scallop shell with a stylized base that extends downward in a leaf-like shape. The shell has defined, radiating ridges that extend from the base to the top edge, and the outline of the object has a slightly wavy, scalloped contour. The main coloration is a mix of earthy brown and green tones, with darker green and brown patches giving the impression of texture and depth. The interior of the shell displays a gradient of lighter and darker green hues, concentrated toward the center and radiating outwards, while the outer edges feature more pronounced brown and green combined patterns. The background of the drawing is plain and beige, with no additional objects or embellishments present.
title: Wood Carving - Shell
